authenticity_review: The image demonstrates strong technical execution in rendering transparent materials (glass chair) with accurate refraction and caustics. However, several artifacts reduce authenticity: (1) The donut glaze exhibits overly sharp, mirror-like reflections inconsistent with real sugar glaze physics (severity 1). (2) Glass chair legs show minor geometric warping at floor contact points where refraction distorts the ground plane unnaturally (severity 2). (3) Flower petals display slight edge bleeding/fusion with background (severity 1). The fine_grained_classifier's failure to recognize flowers (predicting 'hair slide' instead) suggests subtle structural anomalies in petal arrangement that confuse semantic recognition, even if visually plausible to humans. Overall quality is high but contains telltale AI generation artifacts.
